alignment: Both raster assets combine the equirectangular Natural Earth I physical base with boundaries rendered from countries.geojson. The bundled GeoJSON remains the source for country hit testing, outlines, centroids, and the procedural fallback.
editionNote: 2026 identifies the site's modern visual edition, not the date or legal status of the country boundaries.

labels.placement: Official LABEL_X/LABEL_Y positions, deterministic LABELRANK priority, and conservative non-overlap filtering.
